sentences.text: 4. The appeal was admitted on 9.5.2019 and the prayer for bail of the appellant was rejected on merits.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has a good case on merits.
There are contradictions in the depositions of the prosecution witnesses and no independent witness has been examined.
The medical evidence does not support the prosecution case.
The appellant has remained in custody for more than 9 years since 28.11.2013 and there is no chance of the appeal being taken up in the near future.
6. Although time was granted to learned counsel for the State to file their objection to the prayer made in the instant I.A., however no objection has been filed.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the submissions made on behalf of the parties, the material on record, the nature of allegation against the sole appellant which is supported by the minor victim, the prayer for bail of the appellant having been rejected on merits on earlier occasion as also the period that the appellant has Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB)
No.186 of 2019(7) dt.19-09-2023 remained in custody against the sentence of R.I. for 15 years, the Court is not inclined to allow the prayer for bail made by the appellant in the instant application.
8. I.A. no.2 of 2022 stands rejected.

(K. Vinod Chandran, CJ) ( Partha Sarthy, J) Saurabh/-
